# EJS source and licenses

These files are byte-for-byte copies of `yt_dlp_ejs/yt/solver/lib.min.js` and
`core.min.js` in the official yt-dlp 2026.10.21 zipimport executable. Its
bundled EJS version is 0.8.0. `app.py` verifies SHA-256 before starting.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| lib.min.js | c55987fe697e5b9ee18830163f7af85327e9bb5c3e674b969d38c8d205eaa577 |
| core.min.js | 18da6ce0758b416e7ae645084f4f8801f9f9d59d6c477c05eaa0ff94ebd8cc00 |

Upstream release: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2026.10.21
EJS source: https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs/tree/0.8.0

EJS is Unlicense; its complete license is in `LICENSE.EJS`. The original
leading comment of `lib.min.js` also retains the complete licenses and
copyright notices for Meriyah 6.1.4 (ISC, KFlash and others) and Astring 1.9.0
(MIT, David Bonnet). Do not strip those comments when copying the bundles.
